title: Generation
subtitle: 本課限定語境：generation = a group of people born and living at about the same time · 「一代人；同一世代」
description: 本課限定語境：generation = a group of people born and living at about the same time · 「一代人；同一世代」

words.note: 按年齡範圍分類的一群人。
words.example: This age group tends to use social media more frequently.
words.exampleZh: 這個年齡組別通常較常使用社交媒體。

exercises.original: This generation of young adults spends more time online than older people.
exercises.zh: 這個年輕成人年齡組別比年長人士花更多時間上網。
exercises.upgrade: This age group spends more time online than older people.

options.explanation: 研究語境可用，但題句主要按年齡作比較。
更偏同儕互動，不是單純統計年齡分類。
年輕成人 vs older people，是最直接年齡分類。

exercises.original: The survey found that this generation was especially interested in mobile banking.
exercises.zh: 調查發現這個年齡組別特別喜歡流動銀行服務。
exercises.upgrade: The survey found that this age group was especially interested in mobile banking.

options.explanation: 如果明確按出生年份分類才更精確。
調查比較不同年齡層，是最自然選擇。
意思是正在老化的群體，不等於 age group。

exercises.original: People in this generation are more likely to use streaming services.
exercises.zh: 這個年齡組別的人較常使用串流服務。
exercises.upgrade: People in this age group are more likely to use streaming services.

options.explanation: 人口行為按年齡比較，最自然。
研究語域可用，但較正式。
可表示分類行為／方法，不是這群人本身。

words.note: 表示在某一時期具有共同特徵、共同經歷或同時進入某階段的一群人。
words.example: The study followed the same cohort for ten years.
words.exampleZh: 研究追蹤同一批人長達十年。

exercises.original: Researchers followed one generation of participants for fifteen years.
exercises.zh: 研究人員追蹤同一批參與者十五年。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers followed one cohort of participants for fifteen years.

options.explanation: 只按年齡分類，未必是同一批被追蹤的人。
長期追蹤同一批研究參與者是典型用法。
可能指整個研究人口，而不是同一批參與者。

exercises.original: The graduating generation entered university in the same year.
exercises.zh: 這批畢業生在同一年入讀大學。
exercises.upgrade: The graduating cohort entered university in the same year.

options.explanation: 重點不是出生年份，而是入學／畢業年份。
可有社交關係，但不是行政／教育分類。
同一年入學的一批學生正是 cohort。

exercises.original: This generation of patients received the same treatment protocol.
exercises.zh: 這批病人接受了相同治療方案。
exercises.upgrade: This cohort of patients received the same treatment protocol.

options.explanation: 醫療研究中，同一組受試者最自然叫 cohort。
不適合只因接受同一治療便稱為同一代。

words.word: People Born Around the Same Time
words.meaning: 大約同時出生的一群人
words.note: 是對 generation 最直接的描述性解釋之一。
words.example: People born around the same time often share some cultural experiences.
words.exampleZh: 大約同時出生的人往往會共享某些文化經驗。

exercises.original: A generation often shares memories of major events from childhood.
exercises.zh: 大約同時出生的一群人往往共享童年重大事件的記憶。
exercises.upgrade: People born around the same time often share memories of major events from childhood.
exercises.answer: people born around the same time

options.text: people born around the same time
options.explanation: 直接拆解 generation 的核心人口學概念。
地區相同不代表同一代。
職業相同不代表同年代。

options.text: people born at one exact second
options.explanation: 過度字面且不合理；generation 是大約同一時期。

exercises.original: Members of the same generation may have grown up with similar technology.
exercises.zh: 大約同時出生的人可能在相似科技環境中長大。
exercises.upgrade: People born around the same time may have grown up with similar technology.
exercises.answer: people born around the same time

options.text: people born around the same time
options.explanation: 共同出生時期往往帶來相似成長環境。
同時代不一定年齡接近。

exercises.original: Each generation tends to be shaped by the events of its youth.
exercises.zh: 每一代人往往都會受到年輕時期事件影響。
exercises.upgrade: People born around the same time tend to be shaped by the events of their youth.
exercises.answer: people born around the same time

options.text: people born around the same time
options.explanation: 最直接保留「同代人」概念。

words.note: 指年齡、社會地位或背景相近的一群人。
words.example: Teenagers are often strongly influenced by their peer group.
words.exampleZh: 青少年經常受到同儕群體強烈影響。

exercises.original: Young people are often influenced by others in their generation.
exercises.zh: 年輕人往往受同齡同儕影響。
exercises.upgrade: Young people are often influenced by their peer group.

options.explanation: 只表示年齡分類，不突出社交影響。
influenced by 是同儕群體的典型語境。
可能包括不同年齡的人。
通常指分組方式，而不是群體本身。

exercises.original: Her generation at school strongly shaped her fashion choices.
exercises.zh: 她在學校的同儕群體強烈影響了她的衣著選擇。
exercises.upgrade: Her peer group at school strongly shaped her fashion choices.

options.explanation: 可以是同一屆學生，但不一定有實際同儕影響。
學校＋fashion choices＋social influence，非常典型。

exercises.original: Teenagers often compare themselves with people from their own generation.
exercises.zh: 青少年經常把自己和同齡同儕比較。
exercises.upgrade: Teenagers often compare themselves with members of their peer group.

options.explanation: 同時代的人可能年齡跨度很大。
可以作統計分類，但不如 peer group 有社交比較意味。
比較、同儕壓力、社會認同等語境最自然。

words.meaning: 年齡世代群體；同齡群組
words.note: 較正式，表示按年齡劃分的一批人。
words.example: Younger age cohorts showed different media habits.
words.exampleZh: 較年輕的年齡群組顯示出不同的媒體使用習慣。

exercises.original: The survey compared different generations to see how media habits changed with age.
exercises.zh: 調查比較不同年齡世代群體的媒體習慣。
exercises.upgrade: The survey compared different age cohorts.

options.explanation: 正式研究中比較不同年齡群體非常自然。

exercises.original: Older generations were less likely to use the new platform.
exercises.zh: 較年長的年齡群組較少使用新平台。
exercises.upgrade: Older age cohorts were less likely to use the new platform.

options.explanation: 按年齡比較科技使用行為，最精確。
如果研究按出生年份分類也可，但題句只說 older。
加入了「正在老化」的額外意思。

exercises.original: Researchers examined how attitudes differed across generations.
exercises.zh: 研究人員分析不同年齡世代群體之間的態度差異。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers examined how attitudes differed across age cohorts.

options.explanation: 研究比較不同年齡群體的態度，是典型用法。
通常不是拿來分多個年齡層。

words.meaning: 出生世代；同一出生時期群體
words.note: 表示在相同或相近年份出生的一群人。
words.example: The researchers compared two birth cohorts.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員比較了兩個出生世代。

exercises.original: The study compared one generation born in the 1980s with another born in the 1990s.
exercises.zh: 研究比較了1980年代出生世代與1990年代出生世代。
exercises.upgrade: The study compared one birth cohort born in the 1980s with another born in the 1990s.

options.explanation: 不一定按出生年代劃分。
出生年份／時期是明確分類標準。
也可粗略比較，但不如 birth cohort 精確。
兩組都可能是 contemporaries，但不是分類重點。

exercises.original: Researchers followed a generation of children born in the same year.
exercises.zh: 研究人員追蹤同一年出生的一個出生世代。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers followed a birth cohort of children born in the same year.

options.explanation: same year of birth 是決定性線索。
不需要彼此有社交關係。

exercises.original: Health outcomes were compared across several generations defined by year of birth.
exercises.zh: 研究按出生年份比較數個出生世代的健康結果。
exercises.upgrade: Health outcomes were compared across several birth cohorts.

options.explanation: 可以按當前年齡分組，但題句明確按出生年份。
defined by year of birth 完全對應此術語。

words.note: 直接表示屬於同一世代的一群人。
words.example: People of the same generation may remember the same major events.
words.exampleZh: 同一代人可能會記得相同的重大事件。

exercises.original: Members of one generation often remember the same popular music from their youth.
exercises.zh: 同一代人往往記得年輕時相同的流行音樂。
exercises.upgrade: People of the same generation often remember the same popular music from their youth.

options.explanation: 保留世代共同文化經驗的完整意思。

exercises.original: People in the same generation may have similar memories of school technology.
exercises.zh: 同一代人可能對學校科技有相似記憶。
exercises.upgrade: People of the same generation may have similar memories of school technology.

options.explanation: 可能同時代但年齡差距大。
直接、自然，而且保留共同成長背景。

exercises.original: Members of this generation tend to share certain cultural references.
exercises.zh: 同一代人往往共享某些文化參照。
exercises.upgrade: People of the same generation tend to share certain cultural references.

options.explanation: 文化參照和共同成長年代密切相關。

words.note: 表示生活在同一歷史時期的人。
words.example: The writer was admired by many of her contemporaries.
words.exampleZh: 這位作家受到許多同時代人的欣賞。

exercises.original: The novelist was respected by many people of her generation.
exercises.zh: 這位小說家受到許多同時代人的尊敬。
exercises.upgrade: The novelist was respected by many of her contemporaries.

options.explanation: 也可能是同代人物，但更強調相近地位／身份。
文學／歷史語境中表示同時代人物最自然。
單數名詞或形容詞，這裡需要複數。

exercises.original: The scientist's ideas were considered unusual by others from the same generation.
exercises.zh: 這位科學家的思想被同時代人視為不尋常。
exercises.upgrade: The scientist's ideas were considered unusual by her contemporaries.

options.explanation: 歷史人物＋同一時代的其他人，是典型用法。

exercises.original: Several artists of his generation were experimenting with similar styles.
exercises.zh: 他的多位同時代藝術家也在嘗試相似風格。
exercises.upgrade: Several of his contemporaries were experimenting with similar styles.

options.explanation: 藝術史中表示同時代創作者非常自然。
是人口分類，不適合具體藝術家。

words.note: 描述性地指某一特定 generation 所構成的群組。
words.example: Different generation groups may have different expectations at work.
words.exampleZh: 不同世代群體在工作上可能有不同期望。

exercises.original: Different generations may have different expectations about work.
exercises.zh: 不同世代群體可能對工作有不同期望。
exercises.upgrade: Different generation groups may have different expectations about work.

options.explanation: 描述性地把不同世代視為不同群組。
通常是較小的實際同儕圈。

exercises.original: The workplace includes several generations with different communication preferences.
exercises.zh: 工作場所包含多個世代群體，各有不同溝通偏好。
exercises.upgrade: The workplace includes several generation groups with different communication preferences.

options.explanation: 在一般職場描述中可清楚表達多個世代群體。
也可在研究報告中使用，但較正式、精確按出生期。

exercises.original: Marketing teams often compare different generations of consumers.
exercises.zh: 市場推廣團隊常比較不同世代的消費者群體。
exercises.upgrade: Marketing teams often compare different consumer generation groups.

options.explanation: 描述不同世代消費者群體時可用。

falseSynonyms.zh: 人口 ≠ 世代 population 可以包括所有年齡的人。
社群 ≠ 世代 community 可以按地區、興趣、身份等形成，不一定同年代出生。
家庭 ≠ 一代人 family 可以跨很多 generations。
時代 ≠ 一代人 era 是時間時期，不是人群。
十年 ≠ 世代 decade 是十年的時間單位。
同儕 ≠ 完整世代 peers 通常是年齡、地位或角色相近的人，範圍比 generation 小。
詞形陷阱 - generation = 一代人；世代 - generational = 世代的；代際的 - generate = 產生
形似但無關 - cohort = 群體；同期群組 - coherent = 連貫的；一致的
